name: Putative copy-number alterations from GISTIC
description: Putative copy-number calls determined using Gistic2 on the MSKCC Agilent 1M data. Values: -2 = homozygous deletion; -1 = hemizygous deletion; 0 = neutral / no change; 1 = gain; 2 = high level amplification.

name: Capped relative linear copy-number values
description: Capped relative linear copy-number values for each gene (from Affymetrix SNP6).

name: Methylation (HM27)
description: Methylation beta-values (HM27 platform). For genes with multiple methylation probes, the probe most negatively correlated with expression is used.

name: microRNA expression Z-scores
description: microRNA expression Z-scores compared to all tumors.

name: mRNA expression
description: mRNA expression values, median values from all three mRNA expression platforms.

name: mRNA expression z-scores relative to diploid samples
description: mRNA expression Z-scores compared to diploid tumors (diploid for each gene), median values from all three mRNA expression platforms.

name: mRNA expression z-scores relative to all samples (log microarray)
description: Log-transformed mRNA z-scores compared to the expression distribution of all samples, median values from all three mRNA expression platforms.(Agilent, Affymetrix HuEx and Affymetrix U133A)

name: mRNA/miRNA expression Z-scores (all genes)
description: mRNA and microRNA Z-scores merged: mRNA expression Z-scores compared to diploid tumors (diploid for each gene), median values from all three mRNA expression platforms; and miRNA z-Scores compared to all tumours.

name: Mutations
description: Somatic mutations and BRCA1 and BRCA2 germline mutations from whole exome sequencing of 316 samples with matched normals.
